summary: Iter54 — Admin brief maker-suggestions endpoint + UI chips. Backend 9/9 pytest PASS (auth gating 401/403/404, response shape, keywords lowercased, 8-cap, sort desc, required fields, reason non-empty, scoring formula consistency). Iter52/53 regression 22/22 PASS. Frontend verified live on /admin/dashboard → Custom Orders tab: 74 brief-suggestions containers rendered for unassigned briefs (matches funnel 75 submitted − 1 routed), each with 2 chips; first chip has ★ prefix; clicking sets makerSlug (verified: select value='metalart-pro'); selected chip border turns yellow (border-yellow-400); reason text renders under maker name (e.g. '3 matching listings', '1 matching listing'). Brief-funnel-card still renders. Assigned brief correctly skips the suggestions container (74/75 ratio). PAGE ERRORS: 0.

issues: Pre-existing console warning (not iter54): '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning — coming from a <select> somewhere; unrelated to the suggestions chips. Flag only.

critical_code_review_comments: [good] GET /api/admin/custom-orders/{id}/maker-suggestions correctly admin-gated (returns 401 without token, 403 with maker token, 404 for missing order).
[good] Response shape = {suggestions:[{slug,name,location,score,material_match,product_count,win_rate,won,routed,reason}...], keywords:[...]}. Sorted by score desc, capped at 8.
[good] Scoring formula material_match*5 + win_rate*100 + min(routed,5), halved when declined>=3 AND declined>=routed — verified numerically per suggestion via test_scoring_formula_consistency.
[good] Filters: makers with shop_closed/vacation_mode set OR missing email are excluded at the cursor ($ne/$exists filter). Makers with product_count=0 are skipped via early-continue.

[good] Keywords lowercased and set-deduped from order.material + order.project_type. For the 3D-Printed-Piece/PLA brief, returns MetalArt Pro Shop first (score 15.0, 3 matching listings) and williams-cnc second (score 0.0, 1 active listings) — matches main-agent's manual curl result.

[good] Reason string is never empty: falls back to '{product_count} active listings' when no material_match / win-rate / decline signal exists — verified non-empty for every returned suggestion across 74 rendered containers.

[good] Frontend fetchBriefMakerSuggestions is guarded by order.assigned_maker_slug — assigned briefs correctly skip the API call (74 containers for 74 unassigned rows, funnel shows 1 routed = 1 assigned).

[good] Chip click updates makerSlug state (verified: select value = 'metalart-pro' after click). Selected chip gets border-yellow-400 + bg-yellow-400/5. First chip has ★ prefix. Each chip has data-testid='brief-suggestion-{order_id}-{i}'.

[minor non-blocking] Pre-existing React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' appears in console — not introduced by iter54 (the chips render divs, not options). Likely from a different <select> in the admin page. Flag for future cleanup.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — live-verified suggestions chips on 74 unassigned briefs, chip click→select sync, ★ prefix, border-yellow on selected, 0 page errors
